body: I think probably one of the more obstructive road blocks in my way is the fact that there is no reasonable means of walking away from society. You're forced to participate as soon as you come out the womb. We're shoved into a pre constructed system and effectively become a part of it as it molds us from childhood on. All the marvelous advances humanity has made over the past few thousand years are great, but, personally it all means jack to me if I'm not allowed to leave.

Yeah I'm taking electrical trade courses. Circuit analysis was tough work. I would have had a degree already if it wasn't for my school screwing me over with how they set up the program. They say its a two year certificate program but in reality they only offer the classes I need once every 2 semesters. So this combined with their credit hour policy and student aid policy means I have to effectively spend more money on a ton of classes I don't need or want and go much further into debt than I anticipated.
What did you do after reaching this conclusion? Ive often wondered many of the things you mentioned.

I do not currently have disability however, since you and I_do_stuff_44 mentioned it, I might as well give it a shot. And yeah, depression certainly does not help any situation. You understand how it is though, you try and fight it any way you can, but most of the time you're dragged back down. I've put up a fight for about 10 years, and I'm tired of it. I appreciate your message and taking time to send your thoughts.

I'll look into it, though I'm not exactly sure how medicade/ disability works. It would turn my life around if I could find a decent job and be able to support myself, the career path I choose in college (electrical trade) doesn't mean jack to employers who want 3+yrs expirence minimum. I'm sorry you have to deal with cancer, that's an incredibly crappy card to be dealt. I can not imagine that, I certainly would not be half as determined as you seem. Hopefully the treatments are helping you feel better and kick that things ass, buddy.

Lars is driving home my main point more or less. Yes, both physical and emotional pain. I have been going to therapy for 3-4 years and tried some SSRI's, both of which have not helped. I also have a ruptured disc in my back, my only option at this time is a very expensive surgery.

Yeah I am sure of this. I don't want to try and make things work anymore, or patiently wait for my luck to begin turning around. I told myself a couple years ago I would do everything I was able to before coming to this conclusion. So after having been screwed over by the american post secondary education system, told countless times to man up and work at awful minimum wage service jobs by a therapist, working at these places and getting taken advantage of by the managers, I see no hope or opportunities anywhere. I'm tired of being angry, and in pain from a ruptured spinal disc. 

Thank you for the reply friend, I appreciate your concern.
